howToPlay: Use the long range of your basic attack to pressure enemies from a distance. Activate your Super to take flight and drop bombs safely from above, or use your gadgets to control the area and reposition effectively.
gears: Equip Damage to increase your offensive pressure and Shield to boost your durability. Speed is also a great choice for better mobility across the map.
trait: This brawler suits a strategic player who enjoys controlling the flow of battle from both the ground and the air.
